scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana: Per Drop More Crop
other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India.
Applicant must be a farmer of any State or Union Territory.
Subsidy is limited to a maximum of 5 hectares per beneficiary.
Beneficiary must purchase only BIS‑marked irrigation systems/components.
Aadhaar details are required to access the benefit.
The scheme is implemented through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
benefits_summary: Financial assistance is provided for installing drip or sprinkler micro‑irrigation systems (up to 55% subsidy for small and marginal farmers and 45% for others) transferred directly to the farmer’s account via DBT.
